name: nuxt-content-portfolio
title: Mara Yılmaz — Product Designer portfolio & blog
description: Personal portfolio and blog driven entirely by markdown in content/ via @nuxt/content v3. Fully static: `nuxt generate` writes .output/public which any static host or the included nginx image can serve.
persistence: none at runtime; content is markdown in content/ compiled into a SQLite dump at build time (Node's built-in node:sqlite, no native addon)
notes: `npm run generate` = `nuxt generate && node scripts/postgenerate.mjs` (copies the pre-rendered /not-found page over 404.html). Static output only — serve .output/public. Do NOT use an SPA fallback to index.html; every route is a real HTML file and unknown paths should return the pre-rendered 404.html. Build needs Node >= 22.12 (uses node:sqlite). The RSS feed is a pre-rendered nitro route, so /rss.xml exists as a file in the output. `serve` is a devDependency, so run `npm ci` (not `--omit=dev`) before `npm start`-style preview, or use the nginx Dockerfile.
